title: War Comes to Jia Ma
summary: Xiao Yan's vision shows Yao Lao imprisoned in the Hall of Souls by a soul stronger than Protector Wu, but it proves his master is alive. Now a Dou Huang, he trains the Sea Flipping Seal against Medusa's barrier. Zi Yan wakes as a Rank Six Magical Beast but is stuck in a small body, because she has not fully absorbed the Shape-Shifting Flower. Leaving the valley, they find Qingshan Town choking on Poison Sect poison, and Xiao Yan drives off the poisoners and cures the townsfolk. Ka Gang tells him the Poison Sect, the Gold Geese Sect and the Mulan Valley have invaded the empire and besieged the Black Mountain Fortress. Xiao Yan saves Yue Mei of the Snakemen Clan from Gold Geese pursuers with a Fire Ring Explosion. Yue Mei tells him that Medusa is wounded and that the Gold Geese Sect leader Yan Luo Tian and three Mulan Valley elders are pressing her, and Xiao Yan and Zi Yan fly to the fortress.
